rules.writer: llm_model_canonical; skipped: manual-generation, manual-script, mixed, none, unknown
rules.offline: episode_type == 'manual-script'; excluded unless the model has no pipeline episode, then a written=offline row
rules.sample: up to 20 per model: equal-width time bins over the model's date range, one seeded pick per non-empty bin, seeded top-up
rules.length_target: planner midpoint for the recorded target_length at the episode's date; else the task card's 3,800 words
rules.parse_ok: scorers.format_and_length rule (stray words < 2% of all words), with Corn plus at least one other voice required; turn-opening labels: Bernard, Corn, Daniel, Dorothy, Herman, Hilbert, Jacob, Jim, Larry, Narrator, Raz

caveat: Different prompts per model; repetition is length-dependent (r = 0.28); era flags, not a ranking.
